name: Cabbage and Sausage Skillet (Kielbasa)
why: Verified from source page: 435 cal / 14g carb / 16g protein per serving - solidly mid-band on calories and well under the 35g carb ceiling. Structurally low-carb (kielbasa + cabbage + carrots, no rice/pasta/potato/bread base). Single skillet, scales cleanly to 14 (3.5x = ~3 lb sausage, weigh-and-divide friendly). Kielbasa maps to the board directly. CONFIDENCE: high on nutrition (read from published recipe card). CAVEATS: (1) protein is only 16g/serving, below the catalog's 25g+ identity - flag for selector; a build could bump sausage ratio. (2) Near-dup risk vs existing kielbasa-cabbage-potato-skillet and sausage-cabbage-apple-skillet, but this version drops the starchy potato/rice+apple and is the low-carb take the run wants - let adjudicator rule.
